title: Document Chunks
description: Chunk-level data for retrieval, embedding, and citation. Many chunks per document.

doc_id.description: Reference to parent document in corpus

chunk_type.description: Type of chunk: section (stream), page, or caption (figure/table)

text.description: The actual text content of this chunk

heading_path.description: Hierarchical heading path for section-based chunks (e.g., 'Introduction > Related Work > Transformers')

page_start.description: Starting page number for this chunk (1-indexed)

page_end.description: Ending page number for this chunk (1-indexed, inclusive)

then.description: Section chunks should have heading_path for hierarchical context
Page chunks should have page_start and page_end for page boundaries
If page_end is specified, page_start must also be specified
